items.title: Add a narrow orphan surface detector for handler and command registry drift
items.context: The detector should inspect create*Handlers exports, registry registration, command catalog/tool declarations, and runtime command availability. It must have an allowlist for dynamic or intentionally non-command surfaces and must not flag tasks discovered by run-all-smokes.

happy.desc: Detector passes when every create*Handlers factory is either registered or explicitly allowlisted with a reason.

edge.desc: Detector does not flag tasks/*-smoke.ts or dynamic lattice serve/devHost support as orphan surfaces.

adversarial.desc: Detector would fail if a new handler factory is added without registry/catalog exposure or explicit allowlist.

verificationEvidence.note: Detector passed on real source: 102 handler factories registered and 261 catalog commands checked.
Detector explicitly protects dynamic verifier serve/dev-host/browser surfaces and does not scan tasks as orphan command surfaces.
Script contains hard-fail checks for exported handler factories not reachable from createMainRegistry.

items.title: Wire the detector into CI-facing package scripts
items.context: Expose a root npm script such as test:orphan-surface that can run after build or against source as a lightweight CI correctness check.

happy.desc: npm run test:orphan-surface invokes the detector and exits successfully on the current repository.

edge.desc: The package-level script also exposes the detector so CI can run it from either root or packages/main.

adversarial.desc: The script fails non-zero if the detector reports a command/handler surface mismatch.

verificationEvidence.note: Root package script invokes scripts/verify-orphan-surface.mjs and passed.
packages/main package script invokes the same detector from package cwd and passed.
Detector exits nonzero through fail() when handler/catalog mismatch arrays are non-empty; the CI-facing script propagates that exit status.

items.title: Retire only high-confidence unused legacy code without deleting dynamic serve/starter support
items.context: Remove or resolve implementation-review old command code, legacy intent-coverage residue, zod bridge half-surface, and generic verifier API files only where import/search evidence proves they are unreachable. Preserve lattice serve and starter devHost-related files.

happy.desc: High-confidence unreachable legacy files are removed or otherwise retired without reviving obsolete commands.

edge.desc: Dynamic serve/starter support files remain present and buildable.

adversarial.desc: implementation_review_result_get remains an unknown command, proving the old unsigned review path was not restored.

items.title: Verify build and orphan detector behavior on the real repository
items.context: Run the detector and TypeScript build; record that implementation_review_result_* remains unavailable unless deliberately migrated to modern signed review lanes in a future story.

happy.desc: npm run test:orphan-surface and npm --prefix packages/main run build both pass on the real repository.

edge.desc: A direct CLI probe confirms implementation_review_result_get remains unavailable unless a future signed-review migration intentionally reintroduces it.

adversarial.desc: No unrelated active story metadata or dynamic serve files are changed by this story.
